verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.gusto.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the Embedded Payroll docs. Doc pages are served as raw .md and point agents to the complete documentation index. The gusto-cli repo also ships a first-party AGENTS.md written for agents, which the README explicitly tells users to point their agent at. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and the llms.txt probe was truncated, so its coverage beyond Embedded Payroll (e.g., app-integrations docs) is unverified.
